title: Garlic Chicken and Broccoli
ingredients: chicken breast, broccoli, garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Cut chicken into pieces. Saute garlic in olive oil. Add chicken and cook thoroughly. Add broccoli and cook until tender. Season with salt and black pepper.

title: Creamy Garlic Chicken
ingredients: chicken breast, garlic, cream, butter, onion, salt, black pepper
instructions: Cook onion and garlic in butter. Add chicken and cook through. Stir in cream and simmer. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Chicken Broccoli Stir Fry
ingredients: chicken, broccoli, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, sesame oil
instructions: Stir fry chicken with garlic and ginger. Add broccoli. Add soy sauce and sesame oil. Cook until vegetables are crisp-tender.

title: Garlic Butter Pasta
ingredients: pasta, garlic, butter, parmesan cheese, parsley, salt, black pepper
instructions: Cook pasta. Melt butter and saute garlic. Toss with pasta, parmesan and parsley. Season to taste.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
ingredients: rice, broccoli, carrot, peas, garlic, soy sauce, onion, oil
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and vegetables. Add cooked rice and soy sauce. Stir fry until hot.

title: Chicken Tomato Curry
ingredients: chicken, tomato, onion, garlic, ginger, turmeric, chili powder, oil, salt
instructions: Saute onion, garlic and ginger. Add spices and tomatoes. Add chicken and cook until tender.

title: Broccoli Cheese Soup
ingredients: broccoli, milk, cheddar cheese, onion, garlic, butter, flour, salt
instructions: Cook onion and garlic in butter. Add flour and milk. Add broccoli and simmer. Stir in cheddar cheese.

title: Garlic Vegetable Noodles
ingredients: noodles, broccoli, carrot, garlic, cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil
instructions: Cook noodles. Stir fry garlic and vegetables. Add noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss well.

title: Simple Chicken Salad
ingredients: chicken, lettuce, tomato, cucumber, onion, olive oil, lemon, salt
instructions: Cook and slice chicken. Chop vegetables. Combine all ingredients and dress with olive oil and lemon.

title: Garlic Potato Roast
ingredients: potato, garlic, olive oil, rosemary, salt, black pepper
instructions: Cut potatoes. Toss with garlic, oil and seasonings. Roast until golden and crisp.
